The '''Nuala system''' was located in the [[Trans-Gascon sector/Legends|Trans-Gascon sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group known as the [[Nuala Marauders/Legends|Nuala Marauders]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nuala [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-7.<ref name="TEA" />
